scope: Available-state browser audit; see coverage for blocked and unreviewed routes.
findings: Employee directory retains eight desktop columns; row actions require extensive horizontal scrolling.
1041 px table in a 306 px scroller; 16 employees at 390 px.
Use employee cards or keep name and actions visible.
History retains desktop rows; endpoints, duration and description cannot be read together.
639 px table in a 296 px scroller; 10 rows at 390 px.
Fixed template sidebar collapses the actual shift calendar.
256 px sidebar leaves 84 px for calendar at 390 px and about 14 px at 320 px.
Move templates above the calendar or into a drawer on phones.
Charts extend outside cards into the page scroller; right-hand plots and labels start off-screen. Detail tables also retain desktop widths.
Overview content reaches 599 px inside 380 px; other populated analytics reach 574–610 px. Detail tables measure 517–627 px in 298 px scrollers.
Allow chart grid items to shrink and size charts to their containers; provide compact detail rows.
Provider tabs are clipped and have no scrolling container; later providers, mappings and history cannot be reached visually.
691 px tab row inside 358 px at 390 px; later tabs extend to x=704. At 320 px, Personio and subsequent tabs are clipped.
Use the existing scrollable settings tab pattern or a mobile selector.
Template navigation expands beyond the mobile page; the right side of the list and editor is clipped.
Organization template content reaches 684 px inside 380 px; template buttons are 634 px wide. System template grid reaches 668 px inside 332 px.
Make grid items shrinkable and use a stacked template selector/editor.
Vacation policy content expands past the clipped page edge, including search and actions. The Holidays subpage also clips the Categories tab.
Policy area reaches 764 px inside 348 px; search input is 384 px and refresh action starts at x=587. Holiday tabs reach 432 px inside 348 px, with Categories at x=359–445.
Contain the policy table and make its toolbar wrap or stack.
Header actions are clipped; narrow notification bodies also wrap into very short lines.
Header scroll width 364 px inside 346 px at 390 px and 276 px at 320 px. Settings runs from x=286 to x=381 at 320 px.
Stack header actions below the title; reduce fixed-width columns in notification rows.
Week grid clips the final day; horizontal scrolling does not reveal Sunday.
Settled populated grid is 404 px inside a 346 px overflow-hidden container. Sunday starts at x≈381 and ends at x≈421 at 390 px.
Fit all seven day columns or provide explicit horizontal scrolling/a mobile agenda.
Seven-step import progress indicator is wider than the phone content area.
512 px stepper inside 342 px; steps 6 and 7 are clipped at 390 px. Credential form itself fits.
Use a compact current-step indicator on phones.
Global settings cards and form controls extend beyond the mobile content width.
392 px content inside 332 px; input and textarea right edges reach x=391 at a 390 px viewport.
Make form/card grid items shrink and wrap long content.
Lower readiness cards extend beyond the page edge.
395 px card grid inside 348 px; the right card borders are clipped at 390 px.
Constrain card minimum widths and wrap labels/links.
Location detail title and actions remain in one row; Delete is off-screen.
Populated Downtown Branch header reaches 473 px inside 380 px; Delete occupies x=376–473.
Stack actions below the location title on phones.
